title: Boosie Badazz Has Strong Message For Atlanta Hawks Before Season Starts
htmlContent:
Earlier this month, an altercation involving Boosie Badazz and the State Farm Arena security during his performance. After the dispute on the first night of the Legendz Of The Streetz tour. He was banned from the State Farm Arena. The tour featured other artists such as Jeezy, Gucci Mane, and Rick Ross.

He was also removed from the tour entirely following the incident. However, recently the Louisiana rapper took to Instagram Live to share that he and his team have video evidence that the arena's security started the altercation and will be taking legal actions. Badazz has hired the same lawyer as George Floyd, seeking $20 million for his troubles.

"N***a hit my boy with a gun. I got the video," he said. "State Farm Arena not supposed to let nobody with guns in the arena. Ya messed up," he continued.

He will also be seeking a refund for his season tickets for this year's Hawks games of $100K since he is prohibited from entering the area.

"And y'all banned me so send me my $100,000 for my season's tickets back, too. That's part of the suit, y'all send me that. Run that back, too. Since y'all banned me," he continued. "I want $20 million, mane. I got the video right here in my phone," he added, claiming that he also has it in slow motion. The rapper stated that he was the victim, as people attacked him and his crew with guns in the arena."

The Hawks open up the season on Wednesday night against the Dallas Mavericks.
